title: T CUT PARKA
description:
Background: Designed by Demna and his team, the T Cut Parka was initially seen and sold on yeezygap.com in Black.

Though a look for it was taken for the lookbook of YGEBB, it was not edited and released; the look was modeled by Aisha Potter.

The initial design by Balenciaga did feature a slimmer silhouette; this was likely changed by Ye and his team during fittings in December 2021 and January 2022, as samples seen during the time had the exaggerated fit like the retail.

• 09/22/2022 in a shoot with Hannah Rose Dalton
